screen.woodpaneling.onboarding.title: Wood Paneling
screen.woodpaneling.onboarding.strip: Stripping dropped some wood panels! Panels attach to any solid surface — where you click on a face sets the grain direction. Craft 4 panels around a stripped log to restore the log, or 6 around stripped wood to restore wood.
screen.woodpaneling.onboarding.notificat: You collected wood panels from stripping!
